suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific metabolic complication. Require documented short-bowel/short-gut syndrome with a malabsorptive enteric-hyperoxaluria phenotype, particularly colon in continuity after substantial small-bowel resection, and separately documented calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis or stone disease clinically attributable to enteric hyperoxaluria. Do not infer this pathway from short-bowel syndrome alone, and do not generalize PMID 35458207 to unrelated stone compositions or all short-bowel anatomical phenotypes. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
